# OmberCache runtime reference

The runtime version is 4.8. A saved record expires thirty seconds after publication. A pending request times out after thirty seconds. The maximum buffer allocation is 64 bytes and sixteen entries. Output contains twenty-four characters. The fileName is receipt.json. The return value is 100. The creation date records the current calendar day in UTC.

OmberCache.pauseWork uses delaySeconds to wait before retrying. Use --queue_mode to choose a queue strategy. A subscriber starts at its durable cursor after termination; the journal stores the last acknowledged position. An owner periodically renews an exclusive lease before its deadline. Other contenders wait until the lease expires.

An access token is a short-lived credential identifying a caller. Public examples use placeholders; no actual production password is supplied.
